# Variable `QB_DEFAULT_FSTYPE`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

The QB_DEFAULT_FSTYPE variable controls the default filesystem type to boot. It is represented as the file extension of one of the root filesystem image extension found in DEPLOY_DIR_IMAGE. For example: `ext4.zst`.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-QB_DEFAULT_FSTYPE
